name: Trinka
description_en:
Trinka provides writing assistance for academic and technical documents, including grammar, style, consistency, file proofreading and citation tools. Its wider offerings cover institutional writing-process support and publisher workflows.

Language improvement, reference formatting and integrity reports solve different problems. A corrected manuscript still needs an expert to verify methods, data and conclusions; a detector or journal suggestion does not validate research quality.
description_zh:
Trinka 面向学术及技术文档，提供语法、风格、一致性、文件校对及引用工具，另有机构写作过程支持和出版流程。

语言、参考格式及诚信报告解决不同问题，改过的稿件仍需专家核方法、数据及结论，检测器或期刊建议不能验证研究质量。

core_features.explanation_en: Review Word/LaTeX language and consistency; editable output depends on plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 审核 Word/LaTeX 语言与一致性，可编辑输出取决套餐。

core_features.explanation_en: Citation, plagiarism and other reports use distinct credit rules.
core_features.explanation_zh: 引用、抄袭及其他报告按不同额度规则。

en: Revise a methods section while checking units, citations and tracked changes.
zh: 修订方法部分并核单位、引用及修订痕迹。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Use a nonconfidential document copy, inspect corrections and credit use, and compare exported fields.
steps.zh: 用非机密文档副本，检查修订/额度及导出字段。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Subscription plus report/file credits; institution and enterprise quotes.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Basic free with monthly limits; paid tiers use writing/file/page/credit allowances. Several price amounts absent; Confidential Data shows $41.67/month with annual labeling but incomplete total. Quote and team minimum require confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Basic 免费且月限；付费按写作/文件/页/额度。多个金额缺失，机密层显示年付标签月 $41.67 但总额不全，需报价及确认团队人数。

sources.title: Trinka: AI Writing and Grammar Checker Tool right-arrow right-arrow right-arrow
sources.research_notes_en: Academic/technical language help, file proofreading and citation/integrity tools; confidentiality is plan-specific.

sources.title: Trinka Pricing Plans - Powerful Writing at Attractive Value
sources.research_notes_en: Non-expiring Basic with monthly limits, credits and paid tiers; many price cells missing in returned page, team-size wording inconsistent.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Protect scientific meaning during language edits
sections.title_zh: 改语言时保护科学含义
sections.en: For an illustrative methods section, retain units, statistical qualifiers, variable names and citation placement. Check each edit against the underlying experiment, not just fluency. Compare tracked changes in an exported copy, including equations and reference fields. The page describes editable output on paid plans and read-only proofreading access on Basic; neither file behavior was tested.
sections.zh: 例如方法部分，应保护单位、统计限定、变量及引用位置，依据实验核改动，不只看顺畅。导出副本需检查修订、公式和参考字段；页面称付费可编辑、Basic 校对只读，均未实测。

sections.title_en: Separate writing, pages, files and credits
sections.title_zh: 分开写作、页数、文件与额度
sections.en: Basic does not expire and lists 5,000 words/month, five AI requests and four monthly credits, with usage month based on registration. Purchased credits do not expire; unused monthly credits do. Premium Plus includes 240 pages/year shared between standard plagiarism and AI detection; one page is 250 words. Proofreading, advanced reports and citations have separate consumption rules. Unlimited writing therefore does not mean unlimited reports.
sections.zh: Basic 不到期，列月 5,000 词、5 AI 请求、4 额度，按注册日起月周期。购买额度不过期，月赠到期；Premium Plus 年 240 页在标准抄袭/AI 检测共享，页=250 词。校对、高级报告及引用另计，不限写作不等于不限报告。

sections.title_en: Confirm confidential processing and actual prices
sections.title_zh: 确认机密处理与真实报价
sections.en: The returned page leaves several Premium/Plus currency amounts blank; Confidential Data displays $41.67/month with an annual label, but an annual total is missing. No complete quote is inferred. That plan describes real-time deletion, no training and an offline grammar app; these are vendor claims requiring the relevant contract. Team sections conflict between five-plus and a six-user minimum. Cancellation ends renewal without prorated refund.
sections.zh: 返回页多个 Premium/Plus 金额空白；Confidential Data 显示年付标签及月 $41.67，却缺年总，不推完整报价。该层称实时删除、不训练和离线语法，需相关合同确认。团队段落 5 人起/最少 6 人冲突；取消仅停止续费，不按比例退。

sections.title_en: Choose a pilot matching the document and data class
sections.title_zh: 按文档及数据类别试点
sections.en: Trinka merits investigation for technical language revision with human subject expertise. A sensitive manuscript requires the exact processing plan and institution approval where applicable, rather than relying on a generic privacy headline. No checker, upload, API, on-premise installation or detector result was tested; advertised compliance or leaderboard claims were not independently audited.
sections.zh: 具专业人工审核的技术语言修订可研究 Trinka。敏感稿件需对应处理套餐及适用机构许可，不能只依据泛隐私标题。本文未测检查、上传、API、本地安装或检测结果，合规及榜单宣传未独立审计。

research_gaps: No document, language quality, credit use, offline/on-premise installation, API or report tested.
Incomplete price cells, team minimum, security/data terms, source license and self-hosting scope unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
